StartLanding.hookTitle: Do not buy another “all-in-one” business app before you read this free report…
StartLanding.hookSub: What most Malaysian SME owners don’t know about generic software that quietly drains cashflow — and how niche-native ops reverse the damage.
StartLanding.whyBoxBody: Because screaming “Buy Allvisor!” only talks to the tiny % ready to purchase today. The rest of you are researching, comparing, and getting burned by tools that call patients “customers” and classes “appointments”. We lead with education (a High-Value Content Offer) so you can trust the next step.
StartLanding.problemTitle: The real problem isn’t “you need software”
StartLanding.problemBody: It’s that the wrong software forces your floor to speak a foreign language. Clinics inherit retail words. Gyms inherit tuition homework. Shops drown in clinic appointments they never use. Every mismatch costs training time, missed invoices, and unpaid balances you only discover when rent is due.
StartLanding.agitateTitle: Leave it alone and the cost compounds
StartLanding.agitate1: Staff invent parallel spreadsheets because the dashboard doesn’t match the job.
StartLanding.agitate2: Unpaid invoices hide until cashflow panic.
StartLanding.agitate3: LHDN / MyInvois becomes a last-minute fire drill because TIN and invoice hygiene were never built in.
StartLanding.agitate4: You pay for modules you’ll never open — while the workflow you need is buried or missing.
StartLanding.eduTitle: What every Malaysian SME owner ought to know about ops software
StartLanding.edu1Title: 1. Temperature of the message must match the traffic
StartLanding.edu1Body: Cold traffic doesn’t want a wedding proposal on the first date. They want proof you understand the pain — then a free, useful next step.
StartLanding.edu2Title: 2. One organisation should equal one niche
StartLanding.edu2Body: When vocabulary bleeds across niches, reports lie and training never ends. Isolation isn’t a nice-to-have — it’s how trust is built on the floor.
StartLanding.edu3Body: “POS + inventory + LHDN” means nothing until it becomes: sell faster, stop stock surprises, and send cleaner e-invoices without weekend panic.
StartLanding.edu4Body: An irresistible offer is specific and reversible. Start free. Pick your niche. Prove fit on real invoices before you scale seats.
StartLanding.hvcoDesc: 11 traps that kill clinic / shop cashflow — and how niche-native software fixes them. Includes a mini LHDN readiness audit and a niche must-have checklist.
StartLanding.hvcoBullet1: Substantive education — not a brochure about us
StartLanding.hvcoBullet2: Built from real SME ops failure modes in Malaysia

StartLanding.proofNote: Illustrative early feedback — replace with published reviews as you collect them.
StartLanding.proof1: “Dashboard finally says patient. Nurses stopped translating the UI in their heads.”
StartLanding.proof2: “Unpaid + POS in one place beat our spreadsheet pile.”
StartLanding.proof3: “Gym classes without tuition student wording. Night and day.”
StartLanding.faq1Q: Is this just another generic CRM?
StartLanding.faq1A: No. Capabilities and vocabulary are gated by niche so you don’t live inside someone else’s workflow.
StartLanding.faq2Q: Do I need a credit card to start?
StartLanding.faq2A: Start from free registration / trial flow in-product. Prove fit before you expand.
StartLanding.faq3A: Allvisor is built with an LHDN-oriented path (TIN, invoice hygiene, submission workflow). Exact intermediary setup follows your org details.
StartLanding.faq4Q: Can one login run clinic and retail together?
StartLanding.faq4A: One organisation = one niche by design. Link branches of the same niche; don’t mash unrelated niches into one messy dashboard.
StartLanding.finalBody: Cold traffic: grab the free playbook. Warm and ready: start free and pick your niche.
StartLanding.thanksBody: Thanks — that was the opt-in. Download the High-Value Content Offer below. When you’re ready for the next step, start your free niche-matched trial.

Admin.tuitionSettingsHint: Per-branch service charge applied on invoices for this tuition centre.

Lhdn.title: LHDN e-Invoice
Lhdn.subtitle: Allvisor submits e-Invoices to MyInvois as your authorized intermediary. Each shop uses its own TIN.
Lhdn.subtitleTuition: Allvisor submits e-Invoices to MyInvois as your authorized intermediary. Each tuition centre uses its own TIN.
Lhdn.brnHelp: For IG (individual) TIN: enter your NRIC from MyInvois Taxpayer Profile (ID Number). For company TIN (C…): enter ROB/ROC.
Lhdn.linkedConfirm: I authorized {name} as my intermediary in the MyInvois portal (Representatives → Intermediaries).
Lhdn.howTitle: How this works for your shop
Lhdn.howTitleTuition: How this works for your tuition centre
Lhdn.howStep1: Enter your Tax Identification Number (TIN) below and save.
Lhdn.howStep2: Log in to MyInvois → Representatives → Intermediaries → add {name}.
Lhdn.howStep3: Tick the confirmation that you authorized {name}, then save.
Lhdn.howStep4: Submit invoices from Allvisor — they go to LHDN under your TIN.
Lhdn.howNote: {name} holds one platform API credential. Your Client Secret is never required.
Lhdn.lockedPlan: Your plan does not include e-Invoice. Upgrade in Admin to unlock.
Lhdn.intermediaryConnected: Intermediary mode: {name} submits on behalf of each shop’s TIN via MyInvois.
Lhdn.intermediaryConnectedTuition: Intermediary mode: {name} submits on behalf of each tuition centre’s TIN via MyInvois.
Lhdn.demoMode: Demo mode: set LHDN_CLIENT_ID and LHDN_CLIENT_SECRET in env (platform intermediary credentials) to use real MyInvois.
